kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller
Test database connection string with credentials hardcoded in script; should be sourced from .env.example or documentation instead
migrate.stdout can be null even with encoding:utf8; calling .matchAll() without null check will throw TypeError
newestMigrationVersion from .at(-1) can be undefined when no .sql files exist; used in log message at line 175 without null check
Database URL with hardcoded credentials should read from environment variable instead
matrixById() result used without null/undefined check before calling .has()
filePath parameter used in writeFile without validation, allowing potential directory traversal to write credentials outside the project
Array access args[onlyIndex + 1] without bounds check; if --only is last argument without a value, silently seeds all modules instead of erroring
